sections.content: How many people are "marketing and commercial managers"?

81,800 people

were counted on the census as "marketing and commercial managers" in England and Wales in March 2021.

Marketing and commercial managers plan and oversee the promotion of services, products, companies or brands, find new business, plan specifications and prepare details of the requirements for a project and negotiate contracts.

How old are people who do this job?

The largest age group of people who had this job were those aged 30 to 34 years. Of the whole working population 12% were aged 30 to 34 years. For people working as "marketing and commercial managers", 21.8% were in this age group.

The age group with the smallest proportion of people working as "marketing and commercial managers" was 16 to 19 years.

sections.content:
Other jobs that had a similar age profile to "marketing and commercial managers" included:

  • advertising accounts managers and creative directors
  • IT quality and testing professionals
  • speech and language therapists

Select your age group to see the ten most popular occupations for your age

More women than men had this job

Among people working as "marketing and commercial managers" there were more women than men (58.4% compared with 41.6%).

This means "marketing and commercial managers" had a similar proportion of men and women compared with the wider occupation group it falls within of "business, media and public service professionals".

Men made up 41.6% and women made up 58.4% of "marketing and commercial managers"
Across the whole working population, 52% were men and 48% were women. This occupation was one of the jobs for which the proportion of men and women was closest to this overall picture.

Other jobs that had a similar proportion of men and women to "marketing and commercial managers" included:

  • collector salespersons and credit agents
  • environmental health professionals
  • business associate professionals (other)

These are the occupations for which the proportion of men and women was most equally split:

  • quality assurance and regulatory professionals
  • chartered and certified accountants
  • conservation professionals

We can look at who worked as "marketing and commercial managers" by age group and for men and women at the same time to see how these two factors interact.

Among those aged 50 years and older, we see there is a higher proportion of men with this occupation than women.

The percentage of men and women who are "marketing and commercial managers" across age groups

How many people do this job by disability status, employment type and area

Of people working as "marketing and commercial managers", 5.9% were disabled. This means people said they had a long-term condition that limited them "a little" or "a lot" in their day-to-day activities. The average for all occupations is 9.6%.

Disability is more common among people who are older. This occupation had more people aged between 30 and 49 years compared with the whole working population.

People with this job were more likely to work full-time than part-time (86.9% compared with 13.1%).

They are also more likely to be an employee (95.7%) than self-employed (4.3%).

The region of England and Wales with the highest percentage of people with this job was London. At a local level, the areas with the highest percentage of people in this occupation included Wandsworth, this is in the same region of London.
